reserves.name: Coinbase Prime custody (off-chain)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Circle Internet Financial and Coinbase Prime

reserveReview.rationale: Ethena Whitelabel's suiUSDe transparency API reported $13,119,710.160318 of backing on 2026-09-21. The API identified $11,881,911.860536 of USDe, $1,234,896.936595 of on-chain USDC, and $2,901.362187 of USDC held through Coinbase Prime. The live adapter preserves the off-chain Coinbase Prime balance as a separate custody row; the listed balances reconcile to within $0.001 of totalBacking.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ethena Whitelabel issuer transparency API, with backing grouped by token and the Coinbase Prime off-chain custody balance retained separately.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer transparency API identifies the backing token, custodian, network, and amount for every row; its listed balances are $0.001 below totalBacking because of endpoint reconciliation.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-6 (lead usx-solstice)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: The issuer's live transparency API names the suiUSDe backing custodians and wallets: Anchorage 2 and 3 (Sui USDC), Coinbase 1 (Coinbase Prime USDC), Coinbase 2 (Ethereum USDe and USDC), and a Sui mint/redeem wallet. At the 2026-07-20 capture the API reported $13,114,642.84 backing ($12,157,307.86 USDe and $957,334.98 USDC, a 100.14% ratio), but it does not publish legal segregation, insolvency treatment, rehypothecation terms, or target provider shares for this partner deployment.
